title: iPhone 17 Pro is Vulnerable to Scratching, But Not Where You Might Think
summary: Durability testing found the sharp anodised edges of the camera plateau scuff easily, while the rest of the aluminium body resisted scratches well.

title: Apple responds to iPhone 17 Pro scratch and durability concerns
summary: Apple said marks on in-store demo units were material transferred from worn MagSafe stands and can be cleaned off, and that the aluminium camera plateau can show small abrasions over time.

title: iPhone 17 Pro Max durability test: Scratchgate is Apple's fault
summary: JerryRigEverything's durability test blamed the camera-plateau scuffing on design: the plateau's edges have no chamfer or radius, so the anodised coating adheres poorly there.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-17-pro-max
findings.text: The camera plateau's sharp, unchamfered edges are the weak point for scuffs. The flat body and back resisted scratches well.

title: iPhone 17 aces durability test
summary: The base iPhone 17 came through JerryRigEverything's scratch, burn and bend tests well, helped by its Ceramic Shield 2 front glass.

title: OPPO Find X9 Series Launches Globally, Redefining Flagship Experience with 200MP Hasselblad Telephoto, 7000+mAh Battery, Top-Tier Performance, and ColorOS 16
summary: OPPO's press release announcing the global launch of the Find X9 series with a 200 MP Hasselblad telephoto and 7,000+ mAh batteries.

summary: China launch of the OnePlus 15 from CNY 3,999, with a 165 Hz display, 7,300 mAh battery and 120 W wired charging.

title: realme GT8 and GT8 Pro with 6.79″ 2K 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, up to 200MP telephoto camera, 7000mAh battery announced
summary: China launch of the realme GT 8 Pro from CNY 3,999, with a RICOH GR camera system and 200 MP periscope.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro will reportedly have battery downgraded by 13% in Europe
summary: Reported ahead of the European launch: the EU Magic8 Pro ships with a smaller battery than other markets. GSMArena's EU test unit had 6,270 mAh against 7,100 mAh globally.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro Goes Global: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 200MP Camera and More
summary: The HONOR Magic8 Pro's international rollout begins in Malaysia.

title: Google Pixel 10 will soon get a GPU driver update
summary: After reports of stutter in demanding games linked to an outdated GPU driver, Google confirmed that driver updates for the Pixel 10 series were coming.

title: Pixel 10 Gets A Hidden Performance Upgrade — What The New Graphics Driver Really Delivers
summary: Hands-on testing of the updated Tensor G5 GPU driver reported measurable gains in some games, though Pixel 10 gaming performance still trails rival flagships.

title: iQOO 15 with 6.85″ 2K LTPO 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 7000mAh battery launched in India
summary: India launch from ₹72,999 for 12 GB / 256 GB.

summary: Launch-day Malaysian pricing: from RM6,799 for the models on sale then. The 12 GB / 256 GB model, listed as coming soon at launch, is RM5,999 (see the device's prices).

summary: US pricing starts at $1,299.99 for 256 GB, unchanged from the S25 Ultra.

summary: Early Geekbench listings put the Exynos 2600 close to the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 in multi-core, but behind in single-core.

title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra hands-on: Incredible cameras, but maybe hard to get
summary: Global launch at MWC 2026, with UK pricing from £1,299. US availability was not confirmed.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 with Exynos 2600 shows many disadvantages compared to Snapdragon
summary: Tests of European Exynos units found the S26 and S26+ slower than their US Snapdragon counterparts in several workloads, and drawing more power.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8: Release Date, Features & Specs
summary: Samsung's guide to the Z Fold8, unveiled at Galaxy Unpacked on 22 July 2026, with a wider 4:3 main display and 5.5-inch cover screen.

title: Galaxy S26 Ultra Gets a Surprise One UI 9 Beta Hotfix

title: Samsung confirms stable Galaxy S26 One UI 9 update is coming soon
summary: Samsung says the stable One UI 9 (Android 17) release for the S26 series is coming soon, without a firm date.

title: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
summary: A20 Pro on a 2 nm process, a variable-aperture 48 MP main camera, up to 45 hours of video playback on the Pro Max, from $1,299. Available from 18 September.

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max Benchmarks Reveal Speed of A20 Pro Chip
summary: Pre-release Geekbench results suggest roughly 20–28% CPU gains and a much faster GPU than the A19 Pro. They come from prototypes, so treat them as provisional.
